name: forage
description: Forage (spec 4.1): the single manually configured MCP gateway. forage_search searches the Official MCP Registry, Smithery and npm in parallel (plus the mcptoon and MCPfinder adapters and the ingested curated lists); forage_install installs a server through the selection policy into agent-discover, sandboxed, usable in the same session; forage_learn writes usage instructions to the agent rule file; call reaches any installed server. Each tool forwards to a governed NAVA syscall, where INV-10 and the receipt are enforced.

tools.name: forage_install
tools.description: Syscall forage.install (classified medium by the gateway; the result is an experimental, sandboxed server).

tools.name: forage_learn
tools.description: Syscall forage.learn (writes the agent rule file).

tools.name: call
tools.description: Syscall mcp.call (INV-10 checked at gateway step 3 on every call).
